title: Events 2.0
content_data:
> **Important**
> By using Events API endpoints, you agree to the [TikTok Business Products (Data) Terms](https://ads.tiktok.com/i18n/official/policy/business-products-terms) and that you will not share sensitive data with TikTok. Events API 2.0 is now the recommended endpoint for reporting events from all sources, including web, app, offline, and CRM (Customer relationship management) systems. This API provides a unified API schema to help advertisers simplify and streamline their integration. This group consists of the following endpoint: - [Report App, Web, Offline, or CRM Events](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1771101303285761)
